fields.title: Business name search result
fields.description: One record per matching business name for a query (or a single _error/nameExists=false record when a query has no matches, is invalid, or fails). Raw passthrough from OARG's public Company Search tool -- name only; the registry does not expose registration numbers, status, address, or directors through this public search.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query string that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-company-search, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

nameExists.title: Name exists
nameExists.description: True if the query matched one or more existing registered business names; false if the name is available.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed/invalid queries (invalid_query, unsafe_query, upstream_backend_error, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_totalMatches.title: Total matches
_totalMatches.description: Total matching business names OARG reported for this query, before any maxResultsPerQuery truncation.

_truncated.title: Truncated
_truncated.description: True if _totalMatches exceeded maxResultsPerQuery and not every match was pushed to the dataset.

matchedBusinessName.title: Matched business name
matchedBusinessName.description: An existing registered business name matching the query, exactly as returned by the registry. Present only on rows where nameExists is true.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for each search result.
